name: Demon Front Vita
author: Tobic-99
description: A static recompilation of Demon Front (IGS, PGM arcade board) to native ARM code. The game's two programs, the 68000 main CPU and the IGS027A ARM7 coprocessor (Thumb), are translated to C++ and linked with a native runtime that replaces the board: memory maps, the 68000 <-> ARM shared RAM and latches, the IGS023 video chip (software renderer), and the Z80 + ICS2115 sound. There is no emulator, interpreter or JIT on the hot paths.
